title: Templates
subtitle: Reusable plans. Each task stores a number of days before or after the wedding date, never a date.

list.label: The studio's templates
list.emptyBody: Make a template from the tasks you repeat on every wedding, then apply it to a wedding.
list.emptyReadOnly: There are no templates yet. An owner or admin of the studio can make them.
list.readOnly: You can view and apply templates. Only owners and admins change them.

form.name: Name
form.descriptionHint: What this plan is for, for example the kind of wedding.
form.deleteNote: Weddings you already applied this template to keep their tasks.

editor.readOnly: You can view and apply this template. Only owners and admins change it.

rule.before: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} before the wedding date

editor.emptyTitle: This template has no tasks yet.

apply.title: Apply to a wedding
apply.noWeddings: There is no wedding to apply this template to yet.
apply.noDateNote: This wedding has no date yet. The tasks get their dates once the wedding date is known.
apply.becomesHint: The “Becomes” column shows the dates for the chosen wedding.
apply.done: {count, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}} added to {wedding}.
